sloka: ते ऽर्दिता बाणवर्षेण महापार्श्वेन वानराः।विषादविमुखाः सर्वे बभूवुर्गतचेतसः ।। ६.९९.४ ।।
transliteration: te 'rditā bāṇavarṣeṇa mahāpārśvena vānarāḥ।viṣādavimukhāḥ sarve babhūvurgatacetasaḥ ।। 6.99.4 ।।

translations.english: By the rain of arrows of Mahaparsva, the Vanaras were dejected and wore a sad look on their face and lost senses.
